evidence_required: .memory-bank/features/FT-016.md#FT-016-AC-005: RED: after a pending provider return and new search, retry with empty selected photo_ids currently performs zero owner status GETs for the saved order. GREEN: retry performs owner status GET through existing controller.refresh(), keeps the same order, and exposes paid download only after server confirmation; a nonempty selection still follows start(). Empty-selection retry creates zero new order POSTs, browser payment-initiation POSTs or provider create/payment-initiation POSTs. Authenticated provider status GET during owner refresh is permitted and expected for a pending order with provider ID. The existing preparation, card/SBP redirect, failed/unavailable delivery and confirmed-link browser paths still pass. Record separate branch, network, order/provider and UI comparisons in .tasks/TASK-145-T3-FT-016-W15/claim-evidence.md. Preserve pre-existing GREEN; setup failure is not RED.
purpose: Keep the saved paid order reachable when a new public search leaves an empty current selection.
success_outcome: Retry refreshes the retained order for an empty selection and uses ordinary start for a nonempty selection.
anti_goals: No payment history, polling, new state layer, new order, automatic payment continuation or server/API/schema change.

forbidden_scope: Production/deploy, real payment/email, shared operator database or destructive probes
Server payment/entitlement owner, shared API/schema, unrelated Promo/QR and other feature behavior
stop_conditions: Repair needs a new server/shared contract, persistence/history/polling layer or changed product behavior.

constraints: Planning Revision 4 and Constitution KISS; advisory paths do not restrict necessary task-local fixture edits.
invariants: promo server remains the payment and entitlement authority; pending return never grants originals from browser state.
TASK-139 stays failed with exhausted retry budget; supplier proof belongs to done tasks.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-005: In the actual served browser with isolated backend/fake provider, create a paid order, return while provider remains pending, perform a new search with zero selected photo_ids, then click retry. Compare owner status GET count before/after, prove the retained order id is reused and zero new order POSTs, browser payment-initiation POSTs or provider create/payment-initiation POSTs occur. Authenticated provider status GET during owner refresh is permitted and expected for a pending order with provider ID; paid download remains closed while pending. After fake server-confirmed success, retry may show only the existing server-issued bearer link.

FT-016-AC-005: With a nonempty ready selection, retry continues through ordinary controller.start() rather than refresh of an unrelated saved order. Focused unit and served regressions cover both branches plus preparation/retry delay, provider navigation only after ready, card/SBP choices, archive failure without payment, confirmed link and unavailable paid delivery guidance. Use disposable fixture state, safe rerun and cleanup; report request counts, order identity and UI comparison. Existing TASK-137/138 server truth is prerequisite, not adopted proof.
